item.title: Bridges powers Knicks past Raptors 119-92
item.description: Mikal Bridges scored 30 points, including 19 in the third quarter, as the New York Knicks rolled past the Toronto Raptors 119-92 on Wednesday.

item.title: Toronto car exporter accused of laundering money for Hezbollah
item.description: Canada has declared Fahed Sowane a danger to Canada.

item.title: Raptors ‘let one slip away’ against Knicks
item.description: Brandon Ingram couldn't help but shake his head. He knows the Toronto Raptors have to be better at closing out opponents.

item.title: Manitoba calls on Crown Royal maker to give Doug Ford a “path forward” on dispute
item.description: On Wednesday, as he met fellow premiers during a Council of the Federation meeting in Ottawa, Ford once again offered an "olive branch" to Diageo executives.

item.title: Police forces in smaller Ontario cities struggling to pay for new training standards
item.description: A new policing law that came into effect in 2025 raised standards for training and regulations but was not accompanied with new funding for forces to action the changes.

item.title: ‘Not their story to tell’: Humboldt Broncos families angry over Netflix hockey tragedy series
item.description: Sixteen people were killed and 13 were injured when a truck driver went through a stop sign and into the path of the junior hockey team's bus at a rural intersection.

item.title: The Curator: Everything to pack when travelling to Quebec City this winter
item.description: Planning a winter trip to Quebec City? From cold-weather must-haves to practical extras by Helight, Bioderma and Samsonite, here’s what to pack for a magical Canadian winter vacay.

item.title: Corus Radiothon raising funds to build standalone Stollery Children’s Hospital
item.description: The Stollery Children's Hospital Foundation has launched its No Bounds campaign to raise $1 billion for a standalone facility, which is the focus of this year's Corus Radiothon.

item.title: Alberta to introduce stiffer penalties, regulations for towing industry: ‘This has teeth’
item.description: Changes to the Consumer Protection Act include six-figure fines for violators of predatory towing practices, while establishing clearer guidelines for drivers who need a tow.

item.title: Premier Susan Holt set to deliver her second State of the Province address
item.description: Holt has kept a campaign promise to open 10 collaborative care clinics and reached a new $270-million agreement that offers incentives for doctors to work in team-based-clinics.
